checks.claim: v2.1.139 added agent view as Research Preview.
checks.source: GitHub release and agent view docs
checks.note: Docs state agent view is a research preview and requires v2.1.139 or later.
Quick start instructs users to run `claude agents`.

checks.claim: Agent view shows sessions running, blocked on user input, or done.
checks.source: release notes and agent view docs
checks.note: Docs list state groups and state indicators.

checks.claim: Background sessions can continue without a terminal attached.
checks.note: Docs describe a supervisor process and background operation.

checks.claim: Background session edits are isolated in git worktrees when needed.
checks.note: Docs specify `.claude/worktrees/` isolation for file edits.
Release notes list `/goal` as a new command.

checks.claim: `/goal` keeps Claude working across turns until a condition is met.
`/goal` uses a small fast model evaluator after each turn.
checks.note: Docs say the small fast model defaults to Haiku.

checks.claim: `/goal` evaluator does not run commands or read files independently.
checks.note: Docs state it judges only what Claude surfaced in the conversation.

checks.claim: v2.1.139 adds subagent request headers and OTEL agent attributes.
checks.note: Release notes mention `x-claude-code-agent-id`, `x-claude-code-parent-agent-id`, and OTEL `agent_id` fields.
